sources.name: SC OCRM beachfront monuments
sources.agency: SC Revenue & Fiscal Affairs Office / SCDES OCRM
sources.coverage: coastal counties only (Horry, Georgetown, Charleston, Colleton, Beaufort)

control.finding: No public SCGS control-station service found. rfa.sc.gov/gisdata/locate sends users to NGS DSWorld / NGS datasheet search. Only SCGS REST service found is county boundary polygons. SCGS beachfront (OCRM) monument inventory exists as Phase 1-3 maps on rfa.sc.gov/resources/geodetic; no queryable endpoint confirmed.

ngs.note: NGS covers all states; PID links state records to NGS datasheets. Not re-surveyed here.

control.finding_2026_10_12: Rechecked: still no public SC Geodetic Survey station service; NGS (Draw NGS Monuments) covers SC.
control.finding_2026_10_16: Found two public SC Geodetic Survey point layers on the RFA ArcGIS org (county-boundary monuments, OCRM beach monuments). Both served natively in EPSG 6570. NGS datasheets remain the statewide fallback.

roads.name: SCDOT State Maintained Roads
roads.notes: State-maintained roads only (no county/city streets). Counties with their own centerline layer override this (York: NG911 Streets).
roads.checked_2026_10_16: Rechecked: SCDOT Hosted/GIS_Other_Roads has only 178 segments (York), so it is not a statewide local-road layer. No public statewide SC NG911 centerline layer found. Local streets are still a gap except York.
